Rules
2.1. On your own server you play as you like. The admin / admin account is the test account of your installation.[ENTER]2.2. If you share the server with friends, you are its administrator and you keep order: fair play, respect for others, no cheating and no spoiling other people's game.[ENTER]2.3. Do not pass the package off as your own and do not make money from it. Since version 2.2.55 the project is licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (the LICENSE file in the server folder): you may use it and share the official packages unchanged if you credit the author and do not make money from it; you may not share adaptations or separate distributions. Community and help

Changes to these rules
